meta.name: task-coordination-strategies
meta.description: Decompose complex tasks, design dependency graphs, and coordinate multi-agent work with proper task descriptions and workload balancing. Use this skill when breaking down work for agent teams, managing task dependencies, or monitoring team progress.

copy.tagline: 拆解复杂任务，协调多个代理高效执行

howto.what: 它把大型任务拆成可并行的小任务,画出依赖关系图,提供含验收标准的任务描述规则,并监控协作者负载、提示重新分配。
howto.when: 当你要把复杂工作拆给多个 Agent、设定任务依赖关系,或检查团队进度并调整负载时。

say.text: 把这个全栈功能按层拆成小任务,标出谁先谁后。
say.note: 生成任务分解和依赖顺序

say.text: 找出这组任务的关键路径,哪些可以并行?
say.note: 分析依赖图并指出并行项

say.text: 现在各执行者负载不均,帮我重新分配任务。
say.note: 基于当前任务状态做再平衡

howto.what_en: It decomposes a large task into parallelizable units, designs dependency graphs, provides task-description rules with acceptance criteria, and monitors workload to suggest reassignments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when breaking down a complex task for an agent team, setting task dependencies, or checking team progress and balancing load.

say_en.text: Break down this full-stack feature by layer and mark dependencies.
Find the critical path and which tasks can run in parallel.
Rebalance tasks among executors since the load is uneven.
say_en.note: Reassigns tasks based on current state
